information.description:
Devils are Marauders that got kicked out of their family later in life, and thus have more real combat experience. Their gear is still shabby, but you work with what you can get out in the badlands.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Wraiths).
information.notes:
Threat level: Hardened Mook
Facedown #: 5
COM#: 12

Weapons:

  • MilitiaTech N342s Fighter (PQ) [Ironfake Variant M251s Ajax]: ROF 1, 5d6 & Autofire (AR 4) (not built: no item in this module or 0.92.4)
  • Medium Melee: ROF 2, 2d6. x2

Armor:

  • Melee SP (head/body): 2/4

Situational skill values:

  • Resist Torture/Drugs 8 (10)

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.
Throwing hands, does not ignore half armor.
Simple Leather armor for your head. No armor penalty.

Primary Effect

Dose lasts 24 hours.

  • The user rolls 2d6 Humanity Loss which is returned if they pass the Secondary Effect save
  • The user ignores Seriously Wounded wound states for the duration

Secondary Effect (DV17)

When the dose wears off, the user rolls WILL + Resist Torture/Drugs + 1d10 against Secondary DV.

  • On Fail Humanity loss is not returned
  • Unless experiencing the primary effect, REF -2
Provides immunity to inhalable gases or fumes.
No immediate damage. If meat target hit, DV13 Resist Torture/Drugs Check. On a fail 2d6 damage to HP. No Ablation.
